title: 第284章 龙君亲至第283章 送上请帖
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
顾铮闻言，心中一动。绝大多数的蛟龙，其终极目标都是化龙。
用人类的社会阶层来类比的话，蛟龙是普通人，而龙则是贵族。
但这并不意味着蛟龙的实力就一定不如龙，有些蛟龙并不追求化龙，它们满足于自身的状态，实力同样可以达到极高的层次。
而一旦一条蛟龙达到了“即将化龙”的阶段，那就意味着它的实力已经摸到了“武圣”这个层次的门槛。
十几里外，白波湖。
龙吟声滚滚纵横，极远处的湖面波涛翻涌，大浪滔天，一股枭烈雄浑已极的气息正在升腾而起。
恍惚之间，仿佛有一条苍龙破水而出，带着滔滔江水与天际相连，刹那间展现出来的威势，足以震撼整座城池。
龙吟声烈，满城皆寂。
“龙女亲至，老龙不胜荣幸！”
那道洪亮的声音从高空传来，整座城池都为之一震。
无数百姓循声仰望，只见一道魁梧的身影踏空而来，身着一袭华贵金袍，气息张扬霸烈，如同一柄出鞘的神锋，锐利无匹地切开层层气浪，每一步踏出，虚空都仿佛在微微震颤。
“龙君！！”
“是龙君！！”
“龙君亲自降临了！”
“为何龙君会来？”
城中百姓神情错愕，几乎以为自己看花了眼。龙君是何等存在？
平日里连城主都未必能见上一面，更遑论亲自降临城门之外。可今日，这位统治方圆数百里的霸主，竟然亲自现身了。
顾铮的眼角微微跳动。
他凝神望向那道踏空而来的身影，心中警兆大作，这尊蛟龙，当真是深不可测。
他见过燕赤霞，知道燕赤霞的实力起码不低于武圣，但燕赤霞在他面前时，从来都是一副平平无奇的模样，气息内敛得如同一个普通的老头子。

可眼前这尊蛟龙完全不同，它的气息张扬到了极致，那种接近武圣的威压，炽烈如大日当空，令人几乎窒息。
就在这时，十六名赤膊大汉抬着一座巨大的车辇从天而降，稳稳落在城门前方。
车辇通体以金丝楠木打造，镶嵌着各色宝石，四周垂挂着流苏珠帘，华贵非凡。十六名大汉齐齐躬身，声音铿锵有力：“龙君有请，请龙女登辇！”
青青眉头微蹙，低声道：“小姐……”语气中带着劝解之意——这龙君来意不明，贸然登辇恐有不妥。
然而那十六名大汉见敖言溪没有动作，再次躬身，声音比之前更高了几分，虽然字字恭敬，但语气中却带着一股不容拒绝的催促之意：“请龙女登辇！！”
敖言溪轻轻笑了一声。她抬起目光，遥望长空，直视那道踏空而立的魁梧身影，声音清淡，却带着一股天然的威严：“若龙君亲自来抬，或可一坐。”
此言一出，全场死寂。
content_en:
When Gu Zheng heard this, his heart moved. The ultimate goal of most dragons is to transform into a dragon.
Using the analogy of human social classes, dragons are ordinary people, while dragons are nobles.
But this does not mean that the strength of dragons is necessarily inferior to that of dragons. Some dragons do not pursue dragon transformation. They are satisfied with their own state, and their strength can also reach extremely high levels.
Once a dragon reaches the stage of "about to transform into a dragon", it means that its strength has reached the threshold of the "Martial Saint" level.
More than ten miles away, Baibo Lake.
The roar of dragons rolled across the lake, and the waves on the lake in the distance were surging. The waves were soaring into the sky, and an extremely powerful aura was rising.
In a daze, it seemed as if a blue dragon broke out of the water and connected with the sky with the surging river water. The power displayed in that moment was enough to shake the entire city.
The dragon roared loudly, and the whole city was silent.
"Dragon Girl is here, Old Dragon is honored!"
The loud voice came from high in the sky, and the whole city was shaken.
Countless people followed the sound and looked up, only to see a burly figure coming out of the air, dressed in a luxurious gold robe, with a powerful and domineering aura, like an unsheathed divine blade, cutting through layers of air waves with unparalleled sharpness. With every step, the void seemed to tremble slightly.
"Dragon Lord!!"
"It's Mr. Long!!"
"The Dragon Lord has arrived in person!"
"Why did the Dragon Lord come?"
The people in the city looked stunned, almost thinking they had been dazzled. What kind of existence is the Dragon Lord?
On weekdays, you may not even be able to meet the city lord, let alone come outside the city gate in person. But today, the overlord who ruled hundreds of miles around actually appeared in person.
The corners of Gu Zheng's eyes twitched slightly.
He looked intently at the figure coming through the air, his heart filled with warning signs. This dragon was truly unfathomable.
He had met Yan Chixia and knew that Yan Chixia's strength was at least no less than that of the Martial Saint. However, when Yan Chixia was in front of him, she always looked ordinary and her aura was as restrained as that of an ordinary old man.
But the dragon in front of him was completely different. Its aura was extremely exaggerated, and the pressure that was close to that of a martial saint was as blazing as the sun in the sky, making people almost suffocated.
At this moment, sixteen shirtless men carrying a huge chariot descended from the sky and landed steadily in front of the city gate.
The entire body of the chariot is made of golden nanmu, inlaid with various gemstones, and tasseled bead curtains hang around it, making it extraordinarily luxurious. Sixteen big men bowed in unison, and their voices were sonorous and powerful: "Dragon Lord, please invite Dragon Girl to board the chariot!"
Qingqing frowned slightly and whispered: "Miss..." There was a persuasive tone in her tone - the purpose of this Dragon Lord's visit was unknown, so there might be something wrong with him rashly boarding the chariot.
However, when the sixteen big men saw that Ao Yanxi did not move, they bowed again and their voices were a little louder than before. Although the words were respectful, there was an urge that could not be refused in their tone: "Invite Dragon Girl to board the chariot!!"
Ao Yanxi laughed softly. She raised her gaze, looked into the sky, and looked directly at the burly figure standing in the air. Her voice was light, but with a natural majesty: "If Mr. Long comes to lift it in person, you can sit down."
As soon as these words came out, the whole place fell silent.
